goals: Coordinate Matcha Flavoured 1.12.5's Beacon Kindling Wandering Trader lifecycle with persistent exact-player, exact-marker, and exact-trader identity while preserving Matcha-owned content and visible behavior.
Replace only the unsafe scheduled, global, and nearest-selector lifecycle coordination at the eight audited Matcha function seams with active-time pause, resume, and exact-owner cleanup.
Remain a narrow standalone Minecraft 26.2 Fabric companion without datapack or resource-pack overrides.
scope: Intercept only the exact Matcha Beacon Kindling marker-spawn seam and the eight audited wandering-trader lifecycle function identifiers.

Persist one summon record per player with exact marker, dimension, beacon position, phase, remaining active ticks, and exact trader identity; pause while the owner or recorded location cannot be processed.
Suppress legacy scheduled duplicates and global or nearest cleanup while permitting Matcha's original trader-construction function once under the exact persisted marker guard.

Coordinate the pinned Matcha-defined placement effects, messages, advancement revocation, compatibility mirrors, departure, and cleanup outputs through exact identities without changing their intended player-facing behavior.
Moves the existing placement and lifecycle interceptions to the current functions and intercepts the new global no-beacons reset. Keeps the guarded upstream trader constructor.

exclusions: Modifying or redistributing Matcha, or taking ownership of its underlying item, recipe, assets, advancement, messages, placement effects, trader construction, or trades.
Adding data/main overrides, resource-pack content, Stack to Nearby Chests or Quick Stack Nearby work, unrelated Wandering Trader changes, or broad function interception.
Runtime deployment, Test Slot or Test Instance Manager changes, dedicated Workbench mutation, and any access to the protected gameplay instance during this migration.
